name: drive-by
description: Never lose an ask in a long session. Every message you send becomes a drive-by task in a side pane; the agent closes each one only with proof, or drops it with a reason, and is reminded at turn end until none are left.

remindAtTurnEnd.title: Remind at turn end
remindAtTurnEnd.description: When a turn ends with open drive-by tasks, send the agent one reminder that lists them.

skipShortReplies.title: Skip short replies
skipShortReplies.description: Do not log short acknowledgements such as "ok", "thanks" or "go ahead" as tasks.
